scope: Native directory-provider lifecycle through production Fritz/GTO widget structures, plus the focused-label Boolean parameter contract. Existing providers and device actions unchanged.

sources.finding: UpdateVisibility returns before UpdateListProvider for controls that are hidden and cannot focus. This is a different update path from multiimage loading.

Update checks URL/sort/limit changes and starts directory jobs; URL comes from a GUI info label. Pending-job callbacks can also start work, so ordinary hidden-container evidence does not prove all in-flight races.
Parameterized includes substitute caller data into the control tree; the old display-string parameter consequently became part of a Boolean condition.
String.IsEmpty is a supported registered Boolean operation; the correction supplies direct item info expressions.
String.IsEmpty remains registered on the published development branch.

provider_result: Existing widget availability gates work in settled native initial/refresh/disable/reenable phases with the local fixture. Disabled phase retained cached rows but hid both controls and made no further query during three timestamp changes. Reenabled widgets refreshed successfully; no availability rewrite justified.
fixture: Own plugin.video.horizonzv.widgetprobe returns authored local rows only. In isolated XML the Fritz/GTO addon IDs are mapped to that fixture, including their existing enabled gates. The original control types/content/visibility/layout structures remain. No widget Select action or real device/backend provider was invoked.

label_defect.before: String.IsEmpty($PARAM[Dash_Label2]) receives the GTO concatenation of three $INFO display fragments. Native Kodi reports Misplaced [ and Error parsing boolean expression.
label_defect.classification: Invalid existing include/Boolean contract, not a newly removed API claim.
label_defect.fix: Pass a separate Dash_Label2_IsEmpty Boolean parameter. Generic callers test ListItem.Label; GTO tests all three source fields independently with AND. Keep rendered text composition and layout dimensions unchanged.

focused_cases: Eight combinations of empty/nonempty GTO first-place label, channel and Label2; predicate true only when all are empty. Focused empty/full screenshots inspected after existing scroll animation settles.
timestamp_note: The reenabled stage can query the last property value named disabled-2; this name is content, not an execution timestamp. Per-request addon_enabled_at_entry is true for every final request. Disabled-stage snapshots record no new requests.
cleanup: Own process exited, secured settings/addon DB file sets and bytes restored, own fixture removed from addon directory, all mapped XML restored to current production.
limits: No real Fritz login, device action, GTO server/PVR action or real provider-data format approval.
Provider ID remapping is a control/VFS model test, not execution of the original SCRIPT-manifest fallback route.
Settled transitions only; disablement during a running/pending job, every row configuration, rapid races, every container class and aspect ratio remain untested.
Eight focused GTO predicate cases tested natively; the two generic include callers are source/structure checked, not a complete media-widget runtime matrix.
Cached rows while hidden are expected here; not a claim that all internal data is cleared.
Initial helper did not propagate its integer return to process status; report error-list inspection caught the two parser errors. Final helper uses sys.exit(main()).
